prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: second SMALL promotion tile in a three-column mobile homepage row. Full bleed opaque image, exact wide 2.5:1 landscape canvas, approximately 2000 x 800 pixels. It must remain legible at ~155 x 62 pixels and readable in miniature.

Offer from the reference: invite 1 friend, receive R$ 80 and receive 5% commission on wagers. Preserve the invitation requirement and the two numbers. The user requires very little text, clear readability, cinematic polish and real design sophistication. No website name or domain.

EXACT COPY — only these three groups:
"CONVIDE 1 AMIGO"
"R$ 80"
"+5% DE COMISSÃO"
Keep the numeral 1, currency R$, the amount 80, plus sign, percentage 5%, and tilde in COMISSÃO. No extra slogans, long sentences or fine print.

DESIGN LANGUAGE:
A premium editorial promotional card, cohesive with a matte black/bronze small tile beside it, but with a clearly DIFFERENT palette: DEEP PEACOCK BLUE, smoky petrol blue, and cool silver. Dark blue-teal #0b2935, peacock #164b5c, muted blue satin #346579, pearl white #f3f4f1, brushed platinum #d6dee5. Minimal warm champagne highlights on the character's accessories only. Main number is bright brushed SILVER / IVORY, not yellow gold. The dominant environment reads peacock blue, not forest green, purple, burgundy or brown.

COMPOSITION / TYPE:
A disciplined left-aligned grid in the LEFT ~68–70%, an expressive mouse character on the RIGHT ~30%, face/shoulders cropped generously enough to recognize at thumbnail size.
Top headline at about 12–30% height: "CONVIDE 1 AMIGO" in strong clean white modern sans-serif uppercase, tightly kerned and large enough to read, no serifs and no excessive slant.
Center at about 33–71%: "R$ 80" as the enormous dominant visual, with thick confident rounded/geometric sans-serif figures. The 80 is much taller than the headline; R$ smaller but substantial. Crisp flat brushed-platinum faces with only a restrained material sheen. No thick extrusion or bubbly cartoon bevel. Let a small part of the figure's shoulder tuck behind the edge of the big 0 to subtly connect type and illustration without obscuring the number.
Bottom at about 77–90%: "+5% DE COMISSÃO" in one short bright-white line, with +5% a slightly stronger weight or silver emphasis. Use enough font size to be legible at thumbnail scale. NO pill, badge, ribbon, outlined rectangle or banner box. At most one short fine silver divider line as an intentional editorial accent.
Comfortable spacing between title, amount and commission. All text shares an alignment. Keep 5–6% safe margins and no clipping. Amount first, invitation second, commission third, character supporting.

CHARACTER:
A refined cinematic 3D anthropomorphic fortune mouse, warm golden-brown short fur, distinctive large rounded ears, detailed fine whiskers, confident friendly expression, wearing a tasteful dark peacock-blue satin jacket with sparse champagne trim. Mature and premium game character styling, not a baby toy or excessively exaggerated cartoon. It holds one small amethyst-purple gift box with a slender silver ribbon near its chest, echoing the invitation reward. Large clear silhouette with softly lit face; only head and upper body. No rabbit logo, no text on clothing or gift.

BACKGROUND / LIGHT:
Sophisticated softly defocused peacock-blue environment with one broad flowing satin plane and a soft architectural shadow. Restrained silver-blue side light and a small warm rim on the fur give cinematic depth. Calm dark field behind all words. No detailed palace, no dense patterns, no stacks of coins, no balloons, no confetti, no sparkle storm. A little material richness and layered light, not an empty flat gradient and not a busy scene.

AVOID:
Cheap glowing typography, neon colors, gold cartoon outlines, gaudy frames, loud flares, small unreadable paragraphs, overly long text, unrelated props, extra prizes, exaggerated earnings claims. No br893.com, no URL, no brand name, no logo, no watermark, no buttons. Do not add 'até' to the R$ 80 offer because the source explicitly says R$80. Do not invent conditions. Full bleed finished artwork, no mockup, no white border.
